# xmlsquish

> A local-first, deterministic project manager and compiler for XML prompt projects. It creates, formats, resolves, builds, and inspects reproducible prompt artifacts.

This experimental `llms.txt` file is an additive navigation aid for language-model agents. It is not crawler control, authorization, or a normative protocol. Use `/robots.txt` for crawler policy; product and release claims remain authoritative only in the linked repository, pages, specifications, and machine-readable metadata.

## Product

- [English product page](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/): Product model, build pipeline, and CLI quick start.
- [中文产品页](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/): 产品模型、构建流水线与 CLI 快速入门。
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kleedaisuki/prompt-squish): Source code, tests, changelog, and license.

- [English release index](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/releases/): Reverse-chronological catalog of every product release.
- [中文发布记录目录](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/releases/): 按时间倒序排列的全部产品版本目录。
- [English v1.0.1 release detail](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/releases/1.0.1/): Exact changes, downloads, compatibility, and protocol 3.0 migration for the current release.
- [中文 v1.0.1 发布详情](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/releases/1.0.1/): 当前版本的精确变更、下载、兼容边界与协议 3.0 迁移。
- [Machine-readable v1.0.1 metadata](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/releases/1.0.1.json): Stable JSON metadata for six published native archives.
- [Historical v1.0.0 metadata](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/releases/1.0.0.json): Immutable metadata retained for the previous stable release.

## DSL user manual

- [English manual overview](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/): Task-oriented learning path for the XML DSL.
- [中文手册总览](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/ns): 面向用户任务的 XML DSL 学习路径。
- [Getting started](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/getting-started/): Bind the exact namespace, declare a target, and build the first entry.
- [Source model](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/source-model/): Entry, module, import, and source-closure rules.
- [Composition](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/composition/): Macros, parameters, expansion, strings, and structured content.
- [Control and scope](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/control-and-scope/): Conditional matching, bindings, and escaping.
- [Build and artifacts](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/build-and-artifacts/): Validation, XSIR, linking, and published outputs.
- [Directive reference](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/reference/): Searchable reference containing each of the eleven directives exactly once.
- [Limits and invariants](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/en/ns/limits-and-invariants/): Resource budgets, stable language rules, and historical resources.
- [Raw DSL specification](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/ns/dsl.md): Machine-friendly Markdown generated from the normative vocabulary source.
- [v0.3.0 specification snapshot](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/ns/0.3.0/dsl.md): Immutable historical language contract.
- [v0.2.0 specification snapshot](https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/ns/0.2.0/dsl.md): Earlier immutable namespace contract.

## Operational facts

- The stable namespace identity is exactly `https://xmlsquish.moesegfault.dev/ns`; it is unversioned and never localized.
- CLI commands are `new`, `fmt`, `build`, `add`, `remove`, and `inspect`.
- Source installation requires Rust 1.88 or newer and a locked Cargo workspace. xmlsquish is not published on crates.io.
- v1.0.1 is published from immutable tag `v1.0.1`; its six native archives and `SHA256SUMS` are available from GitHub Releases.
- Machine-event consumers must migrate from protocol 2.1 to protocol 3.0 together with v1.0.1.
